why:
All three checks confirm the finding.

(1) QUOTE VERBATIM. curl -sL https://code.claude.com/docs/en/amazon-bedrock.md, line 433 (of 551), under '## Use the Mantle endpoint': "Mantle is an Amazon Bedrock endpoint that serves Claude models through the native Anthropic API shape rather than the Amazon Bedrock Invoke API. It uses the same AWS credentials, IAM permissions, and `awsAuthRefresh` configuration described earlier on this page." The claimed sentence is the first of two on that line, word for word; the second sentence reinforces rather than reverses it (Mantle rides the same AWS credential path). The page's own env table (:495-497) lists CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE, ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_MANTLE_BASE_URL, CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_MANTLE_AUTH, and :460 says setting CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK and CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE together makes Claude Code call both endpoints from one session.

(2) CITED FILE. packages/shared/src/agent/options.ts:236-265. :239-245 builds the subprocess env as `{...process.env, ...getProxyEnvVars(), ...envOverrides, NESSY_DEBUG}`; :257-259 carries the comment 'Bedrock must never be routed through the Claude SDK path. Strip only Claude-specific Bedrock routing vars here...'; :260-262 are exactly three deletes — CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK, AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK, ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL. Cited line numbers are accurate.

(3) ABSENCE, with -a. `rg -a -i mantle` over the whole tree (excluding .git and .references) returns hits ONLY inside the doc-sweep's own artifacts under docs/superpowers/specs/ — zero hits in packages/, apps/, scripts/. No NUL-byte skip: -a was passed.

(4) CONSEQUENCE, measured separately from the identifier, with a positive control. A probe imported the real buildClaudeSubprocessEnv with all five vars set in process.env. Result: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK -> null, ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL -> null (the control fires — the strip list works), CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE -> '1', ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_MANTLE_BASE_URL -> 'https://mantle.example', CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_MANTLE_AUTH -> '1'. The three Mantle vars reach the subprocess.

(5) IS THE RECEIVING BINARY EVEN LISTENING? Yes. We pin @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.183 (root, core, shared package.json). The bundled native binary node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64/claude contains CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE (17 occurrences), ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_MANTLE_BASE_URL (12) and CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_MANTLE_AUTH (12), and its provider-flag tables list CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE alongside USE_BEDROCK/USE_VERTEX/USE_FOUNDRY/USE_ANTHROPIC_AWS/USE_GATEWAY. So this is NOT the 'identifier unwired but consequence already handled upstream' shape — the routing lives in the binary we ship. (The SDK's sdk.mjs/bridge.mjs mention it only to suppress error reporting under a cloud provider, which is itself evidence the flag is a live provider selector.)

(6) ONE LAYER UP. The strip is duplicated, and the duplicate is equally incomplete: packages/shared/src/config/llm-connections.ts:931-935 defines CLAUDE_BEDROCK_ROUTING_ENV_KEYS (the same three), consumed by clearClaudeBedrockRoutingEnvVars() at claude-agent.ts:917 in postInit ('Claude subprocesses must never inherit Bedrock-routing toggles from a previous connection or parent process environment') and folded into MANAGED_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_ENV_KEYS. Nothing upstream sanitizes Mantle. So a fix has three sites, not one: options.ts:260-262, the llm-connections constant, and its tests.

(7) NOT AN OWNER DECISION, NOT A PRODUCT DIFFERENCE. 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3's nine dated decisions are SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, and listSessionSummaries/listSessions — none is this. Nor is it the fork's deliberate scope: the finding does not ask us to SUPPORT Mantle (we ship no Bedrock provider, and that part of the page is correctly inapplicable); it observes that our own stated Bedrock-isolation invariant is under-enforced by exactly the vars the page adds. packages/shared/AGENTS.md:37 documents the sanitization as an active invariant, so the gap is inside a live contract, not outside the product boundary.

Severity note, not a refutation: exposure requires the host shell to already export CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE (plus AWS credentials or a gateway) — the same precondition as CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK, which we do strip. The asymmetry is the defect.
correctedState: CONFIRMED as stated, with two additions. buildClaudeSubprocessEnv (packages/shared/src/agent/options.ts:239-245) spreads the whole ambient process.env and deletes exactly three vars (:260-262) under the invariant 'Bedrock must never be routed through the Claude SDK path'; a measured probe shows those three are removed while CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE, ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_MANTLE_BASE_URL and CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_MANTLE_AUTH survive into the subprocess, and the native binary we bundle (@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.183, darwin-arm64) honours all three. Addition 1: the strip list is duplicated at packages/shared/src/config/llm-connections.ts:931-935 (CLAUDE_BEDROCK_ROUTING_ENV_KEYS, used by clearClaudeBedrockRoutingEnvVars at claude-agent.ts:917) and is missing the same vars, so any fix touches both sites plus llm-connections-auth-env.test.ts / managed-env.test.ts. Addition 2: Mantle is not the only omission — the same bundled binary carries CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ANTHROPIC_AWS (with ANTHROPIC_AWS_BASE_URL / ANTHROPIC_AWS_API_KEY / CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_ANTHROPIC_AWS_AUTH) and CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY as provider selectors, none of which we strip either (overlaps f118). The correct fix is a single shared allowlist of Claude provider-routing env keys, derived from the binary's provider-flag set, rather than three more hardcoded deletes.
